respuesta.pregunta: For vendor-stockkeeper-api 0.0.6-ep-restock-man, what tables are in the inventory database and what columns do they have? I need the schema before I do a manual restock straight in the DB.
respuesta.respuesta:
I can't answer this from the 0.0.6-ep-restock-man documentation. None of the documents for this version describe the inventory database's tables or columns.

The database guide only gives connection details for three environments: Test (inventtest), Stage (inventstg) and Prod (inventprd). All three use host proxysql.master.techzoneseginf.com and port 6612 [vendor-stockkeeper-api/0.0.6-ep-restock-man/guide/database.md:L2-L23]. It doesn't list any tables, columns or other parts of the schema.

You'll need to get the schema somewhere else, for example by checking the database directly or asking the team that owns it.
